result.title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
result.summary: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. These repairs depend on a trace of how the faults were computed. The original weights have 16-bit precision, and faults computed in 32-bit arithmetic leave low bits that only the damaged weights carry. Rounding those bits away leaves each model's answers to our test questions unchanged, and the agent, unaided, then restores no weight exactly: on SmolVLM it no longer finds the damage, and in a single session on LFM2-VL its only gain comes from rescaling answer-token embeddings, which changes how often the model answers yes. Marking the damaged weights again in their low bits brings the edits back to them. Rounded weights still hold statistical evidence of the rescaling, in the distribution of stored values and in row norms, and one sentence in the prompt that names such a statistic directs the agent's edits to the damaged rows on both models. Swapped rows or columns, which leave the set of stored values unchanged, are not found unaided on either model within our session budgets. We recommend that studies of weight repair report the number format of the weights and include a rounded control.

AI.brief_summary: 研究无梯度的权重空间编程修复 VLM 究竟依赖什么：在 SmolVLM-256M 与 LFM2-VL-450M 的权重中植入故障，考察编码 agent 能否自主定位 projector 中被缩放的行与 vision encoder 中的噪声并精确还原，发现修复成败取决于故障计算留在低位的痕迹，取整后即失效，并建议报告权重量化格式、加入取整对照。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文本身不研究 latent 推理，但其对 projector 与 vision encoder 权重低位精度的分析及取整对照，可能可供核查视觉信息在内部参数与状态中的可辨识度和精度边界，属方法性借鉴线索。
